title: Fāṭima bint Yūsuf, daughter of Yūsuf I and widow of Francesc de Montsoriu, dies at fifty-one. Her son Berenguer Ramon rules the Ṭāʾifa of Catalonia, her daughter Isabel is the wife of the heir Muḥammad, and another daughter is married to Saʿd ibn Ismāʿīl of Shalamanka

children: a daughter married to Saʿd ibn Ismāʿīl, ruler of Shalamanka
Berenguer Ramon de Montsoriu, ruler of the Ṭāʾifa of Catalonia (born 1380)
Isabel de Montsoriu (born 1382), wife of the heir Muḥammad
